formal_statement: ∃ (c m0 : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ m n : ℕ, m0 ≤ m → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → m ^ 3 ≤ c * n
plain_statement: CLAIM OF AN UNREFEREED MANUSCRIPT, not verified here: for some constant c and all large m, every border determinantal expression of perm_m has size at least m^3 / c (the manuscript states c = 5529600 e and m at least 1408). Follows from L-gct-023, 024 and 025 by restricting perm_m to perm_11k. Source: the manuscript of 24 September 2026 cited by arXiv:2610.40484. The best refereed bound is m^2/2 (L-gct-010).
title: Cubic lower bound for border determinantal complexity of the permanent (unrefereed 2026 claim)
